description: Create comprehensive unit tests and update pom.xml with required dependencies
steps: Update pom.xml to add dependencies: spring-boot-starter-security, spring-security-test, springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui, jjwt-api, jjwt-impl, jjwt-jackson for JWT support.

Create TransferServiceTest.java in src/test/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/service/ with unit tests for: initiateTransfer validation, insufficient balance, account not found, daily limit exceeded, successful transfer.
Create TransferControllerTest.java in src/test/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/controller/ with @WebMvcTest for testing REST endpoints with MockMvc.
Create SecurityConfigTest.java in src/test/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/config/ for security configuration testing.
Create KafkaProducerServiceTest.java in src/test/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/kafka/ for testing Kafka event publishing.
Create test data builders for Transfer, TransferRequest, TransferResponse using Builder pattern.
Add @MockBean for Feign clients in controller tests.
Add test coverage for all business rules and edge cases.
Ensure all test classes follow the same package structure as production code (src/test/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/).
Add integration test for end-to-end transfer flow using @SpringBootTest.
acceptance_criteria: All unit tests pass with mvn test
Test coverage exceeds 80% for service and controller layers
Security tests verify role-based access control
Integration test validates complete transfer flow
verification: Run mvn test to execute all unit tests
Run mvn clean verify to run full test suite
Check test coverage report in target/site/jacoco/
